sloka: कुशनाभ सुतः तु आसीत् गाधिः इति एव विश्रुतः ।गाधेः पुत्रो महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः ॥१-५१-१९॥
transliteration: kuśanābha sutaḥ tu āsīt gādhiḥ iti eva viśrutaḥ ।gādheḥ putro mahātejā viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ॥1-51-19॥

translations.english: Wellknown Gadhi was the son of Kusanabha. Highly lustrous and mighty ascetic Viswamitra is the son of Gadhi.
